Administration

Cost Centres

📅 Published June 2025 📂 Platform: Keytelemetrics 👤 Audience: Administrators

Cost Centres restrict access and visibility between different divisions of the same company. Users and Assets are assigned to Cost Centres — users can only see, report on, and create alerts for assets within their own Cost Centres.

Applies to: Users  ·  Assets  ·  Locations  ·  Alerts  ·  Reports

1. How Cost Centres Work

Cost Centres use a parent-child hierarchy. There is a single parent at the top, beneath which children are created. Children can themselves become parents with further children beneath them.

As an example, Example Inc has operations in South Africa (Gauteng and Western Cape) and Cross Border (Zambia and Zimbabwe). An organisational chart looks like this:

User LevelAccess
Depot user (e.g. Gauteng)Only sees assets in their own Cost Centre
Regional manager (e.g. South Africa)Sees all depots in their region only
Head officeSees all assets across every Cost Centre
Tip: Plan your Cost Centre hierarchy to match your actual organisational structure before creating it in the platform.

2. Creating Cost Centres

Step 1 — Navigate to Cost Centres

Go to Administration → Organisation → Cost Centres:

Step 2 — Rename the Default Cost Centre

Select Default, click Edit, rename it to your top-level name (e.g. "HQ"), and click Save:

Step 3 — Add Child Cost Centres

Click the + button. The first child must be created under the renamed parent:

After the first child is created, new Cost Centres can be added under any existing parent or child:

Keep adding until your full structure is complete:

3. Editing Cost Centre Information

Edit any Cost Centre to change its Name or Parent, and to add Contacts. Contacts appear on the Overview and Alerts screens with clickable links.

Adding a Contact

Click Edit next to Contacts, then Add to open the Contact Details form:

Once saved, the contact displays with clickable email and phone links:

FieldDescription
NameContact person's full name
TypeOwner, Technical, Emergency, etc.
EmailClickable email shown on asset overview
MobileClickable mobile number on overview
PhoneLandline / office number
NotesAdditional context shown with the contact

4. Viewing Assets and Users in a Cost Centre

Select a Cost Centre, then open the Assets or Users section to see everything assigned to it.

Assets assigned to the Cost Centre:

Users assigned to the Cost Centre:

Key difference from Asset Groups: Cost Centres control who can see what. Asset Groups control how assets are categorised. Both can be applied simultaneously.
